Kanban card briefs to triage:
1. [2026-11-12-155922-wiki-login-polish] wiki-login-polish wiki polish leftovers from wiki-login-broken card (closed): (1) PluggableAuth Google button still renders label "0" on Special:UserLogin — give it a real label (e.g. "Sign in with Google") via $wgPluggableAuth_Config in LocalSettings.php, FTP path same as members edit, backup first
2. [ada-acl-explain] Three overlapping ACL systems answer differently: control_policies domain lists, ~/.config/ada/device-grants.json overlay, and per-bank allowed_tools. ada_device_acl patched one room's need; the unification is still ahead. Waiting in backlog.
3. [ada-card-loop-tiers] Tony wants Ada inside the same loop we just found: inspect card → ask → educate each other. This card defines how far she may go on her own and how we measure readiness. Expected action: review the tier table below; T0–T2 need no approval (mechanisms exist), T3+ gates on bench scores.
4. [ada-dead-surface-metric] Shape is lint-verified (42 declared), usage is not. Some census names had zero calls in 7d — the surface may carry dead weight the merge program cannot see. Waiting in backlog.
5. [ada-deploy-preflight-gate] Last missing piece of the Ada dev-control-plane loop. Cards currently merge to done with no production-deploy stage. Build the gate: card declares deploy target, system collects preflight evidence, Tony approves explicitly, deploy runs, post-deploy surface is verified.
6. [ada-dev-control-plane-envelope] Give Ada, Node-RED, OpenCode, Cline, and DevNest one durable task contract so intent becomes verified execution without losing project context.
7. [ada-gemini-quota-breaker] Stop the 1008 reconnect-storm when Gemini Live hits quota (429/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED). Evidence: jobs/ada/2026-10-10-audit-fail-cluster.yml — 1389x429, 643x RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, 198x quota_exhausted, ws close 1008 looping all evening on idc03 ada-ha-tony.
8. [ada-ha-dashboard-live-view-drift] The live Ada HA dashboard has Hosts/Services tabs but lacks Ada Control, unlike the pre-change repo snapshot; verify whether this drift is intentional before restoring anything.
9. [ada-ha-hardening] ada-ha stops being the disposable lab and becomes Tony's stable private HA. Dev work moves to ada-dev; ada-ha keeps running and gets backup/health coverage.
10. [ada-ha-kanban2-tab] Preserve the classic Board iframe in the existing Kanban tab; add the new Board2 layout immediately after it as a separate Kanban 2 tab.
11. [ada-nest-real-job-plan] Coordinate the next real Ada Nest jobs with explicit host/resource gates. Omen has 38G data free; T4 is for GPU-heavy image/voice/embedding work; JEV arena expands before autonomous routing.
12. [ada-nest-trivial-gate] Extend the relay gate cascade (silence->STT->trivial-filter) with one more rung: a tiny local specialist that answers trivial queries (greetings, time/date, acks) without burning an Ada/provider turn. NCM-inspired adaptive-depth pattern.
13. [ada-ocb-answer-eval] Tool-call benchmarks verify plumbing; nothing verifies the agent actually answers correctly. Build a small eval set that asserts answer quality end-to-end.
14. [ada-ocb-answer-eval-r2] Re-run of ADA-0175: r1 produced a good harness (ocb-eval.py, 10 cases, tools-mode 10/10) but the branch eval/ocb-answer-eval @442cfc7 lived in a scratch clone inside a GC'd worktree and is LOST. Rebuild it — the analysis is in ADA-0175 comms.
15. [ada-ocb-board-read-latency] ada_status/card_context/card_pick/next_card hit the 9MB /cards dump (13-16s) exceeding the OpenCode MCP timeout; calls completed server-side but agents saw timeouts. Route through compact index + projected snapshot + single-card hydration; guard string comms/requests/action rows.
16. [ada-ocb-bridge-version] We found Devin's ada-control MCP running a 23-tool stale bridge while OpenChamber had 25 — no way to tell which code a session is talking to. Add a version stamp.
17. [ada-ocb-kanban-sweep-report] The card-ops-sweep skill and card-status procedure already define evidence-first triage; add a callable Ada-OCB tool to produce one timestamped summary of stuck, failed, and misplaced work without dispatching or mutating cards.
18. [ada-ocb-manual-queue-semantics] The Ada-OCB queue picker labels queued action.type=manual cards as queued for dispatch, while board runners reject them as unsupported. Make the response accurately identify human-only work without changing card state or inventing an executor.
19. [ada-ocb-regression-suite] Lock in this week's ada-ocb improvements (context_pack, ssot_get, windowed excerpts, MDDB lessons, vector-search, board snapshots, string-row guards) with regression coverage so they can't silently rot.
20. [ada-opencode-nl-card-resolve] Tony should be able to say things like "hibiscus GS project status" or "the media pack card" and have Ada/OpenCode resolve the right kanban card instead of failing with "no board card matched".
21. [ada-opencode-repair-menu-card] Phase 1/3 of OPS-1109 UI: Ada chat card shows candidate + Keep/Reject/Revise/Repair-region buttons; Repair opens mask-picker; picker POST /submit already lands in inbox + board comment. Remaining: card JS buttons, decision endpoint -> SESSION/QC, deploy idc03.
22. [ada-printer-diagnostics-safe-repair] Extend Ada's existing confirmed document-print tool with printer status, CUPS job diagnostics, and bounded repair actions.
23. [ada-session-audit-daily] The ada-transcript-audit skill only runs when Tony asks. Schedule it: daily audit of yesterday's sessions — phantom tool claims, failed calls Ada glossed, repeated asks, confirm-gate friction — published as a CMS page and filed to focus-inbox/cards when friction is found. Labels feed the Ada corpus.
24. [ada-track-lost-persist] ada_track_device action='lost' arms an in-process watcher that dies with the backend (volatile by design for v1). A lost-device watch should survive deploys and restarts — that is exactly when it matters. Waiting in backlog.
25. [ada-wiki-extension-confirm-flag] Follow-up from wiki-extension-control-plane: board-api /wiki/extension now requires confirm=true on install|enable|disable; ada-voice backend/tools.d/wiki_extension.py does not send it, so Ada-side mutations will 400 once the hardened door deploys.
26. [adobe-stock-artifact-landing-service] Replace the ad-hoc decode/hash/rclone/session-update command chain with one typed landing call per render.
27. [adobe-stock-illustration-pivot-test] Re-keyword the painterly comparison-c for Adobe Stock illustration/flat-design category.
28. [adobe-stock-upscaler-eval] Benchmark Real-ESRGAN, SwinIR, SeeSR/OSEDiff on campaign assets; pick pipeline upscaler.
29. [ai-workforce-eval] Eval which (surface × brain × task class) lane carries real work cheapest with gate-passing quality, so capped/expensive lanes re-route instead of stalling.
30. [ansible-ada-ocb-tony-dell-fallback] Follow-up from OPS-1424: tony-dell ocb_pane fallback probe incomplete in ada-ocb-verify; align pin/patch/service state or harden verify for missing fallback probe.
31. [ansible-disk-headroom-harden] From idc02, ansible SSH to its own tailnet IP failed (publickey). Add controller auto-detect (ansible_connection: local), document --check --diff dry-run, feed samples into disk-trend jsonl history, seed IP host keys.
32. [ansible-prep-plan-apply-verify] Standardize Ansible for preparation/baselines, check-diff plan artifacts, gated apply, and verified closeout to increase fleet efficiency.
33. [ansible-vs-legacy-fleet-benchmark] Side-by-side benchmark: ansible playbooks vs audit-hosts.py / sync-runner-tools.sh / guard scripts on service-audit, disk-guard, runner-tool-sync candidates. Read-only, report with verdicts.
34. [app-retirement-sweep] Tony 2026-11-09 approved retiring likely-dead apps. Each gets docs/kb/retired-apps/<app>.md with restore steps + status:retired markers; cline and node-red confirmed first.
35. [audit-auto-macbook] Four post-change audit deltas; reconcile intended roles before enabling or stopping units.
